Code implements D = 1.34 x (q^2/f)^(1/3) with q = 1.30 x Q / L, where L is the MEASURED linear waterway when supplied (input `linearWaterway_m`, source L4845 = 28.80 m) and otherwise the computed B_eff = Q/V; D_m = 1.5 x D. The former 1.27 x D constant is the downstream cut-off factor, a different quantity.
notes: CODE FIXED 2026-11-18 (E3 + Task 26): (a) normal-scour form changed from the classic Lacey 0.473*(Q/f)^(1/3) to the reference 1.34*(q^2/f)^(1/3); (b) optional linear-waterway input added so q is taken from the measured waterway (L4845), which reproduces the golden set. With Q = 45.75, L = 28.80, f = 2.00: app q = 2.0651, D = 1.7247 m, D_m = 2.5871 m vs reference 1.75 / 2.63 m, i.e. 1.5% low.
